newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi December oil output 8.008 million bpd.
newsitem.headline: Saudi December oil output 8.008 million bpd.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's crude oil output averaged 8.008 million barrels per day (bpd) in December but supplies to the market were 7.989 million bpd, Gulf sources familiar with Saudi Arabia said on Tuesday.
Saudi Arabia's crude output in November was 8.012 million bpd and supply at 8.001 million bpd, official submissions to the OPEC secretariat in Vienna last month showed.
OPEC oil quotas are based on supply to the market rather than well-head production.
Supply to the market is calculated as domestic consumption, plus net export sales of crude and products, plus withdrawls of stocks held outside national boundaries.
Riyadh's OPEC supply quota is 8.000 million bpd.
